headlines.title: Families concerned about reports of mental health crisis on USS Lincoln
headlines.description: Families of marines are voicing concern over reports about the USS Abraham Lincoln, a naval aircraft carrier based in San Diego that has been in the Middle East supporting the Iran war for over 200 days. Families say their loved ones onboard are dealing with food shortages, plumbing problems and mental health issues. NBC News’ Dan De Luce reports on the lawmakers demanding answers and the broader implication that the war in Iran is having on the military.

headlines.title: Luigi Mangione is expected to plead guilty to federal charges, sources tell NBC News
headlines.description: Luigi Mangione is expected to plead guilty to federal charges in connection with the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan, according to sources familiar with the matter. NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris reports on what kind of prison time Mangione could potentially be looking at, as well as what charges he may plead guilty to.

headlines.title: Kennedy Center board votes to partially close arts center during renovations and add Trump’s name to the building again
headlines.description: The Trump-appointed Kennedy Center board on Thursday voted to partially close the iconic arts center for up to two years during renovations and to re-add President Donald Trump’s name to the building’s facade, according to one person who attended the virtual board meeting and a second person familiar with the meeting.

headlines.title: Surveillance company Flock moves to increase oversight after police misuse
headlines.description: Flock Safety, the police tech company that tracks Americans’ vehicle movements through a line of cameras, announced Thursday that it would implement several new safeguards to its products.

headlines.title: London’s green parks turn brown after weeks of extreme heat
headlines.description: Weeks of extreme heat and dry conditions have had a visible impact across London, turning the British capital’s green parks into a sea of brown.

headlines.title: Dog Rescued From Colombia Quake Offers Hope to Find Survivors
headlines.description: The search for survivors in Colombia is entering a fourth day and growing more desperate by the hour following Monday’s earthquake. It comes as firefighters pulled a trapped dog to safety, offering a glimmer of hope in finding more survivors. NBC’s George Solis reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Ticks that cause Lyme and other diseases have migrated south. Are doctors ready?
headlines.description: Ticks that carry Lyme and other diseases have gained a foothold in unexpected areas and should be considered a major threat farther south, a new CDC report finds.

headlines.title: The showdowns and reunions highlighting the NBA’s 2026-27 season
headlines.description: The NBA’s offseason was defined by team-switching superstars — which meant that when the league released its schedule Thursday, its regular-season schedule was highlighted by those stars’ returns to the cities that once cheered for them.

headlines.title: Judge dismisses Trump administration lawsuit alleging Harvard failed to protect Jewish students
headlines.description: A federal judge dismissed a lawsuit Thursday by the Trump administration ‌that alleged that Harvard University failed to protect Jewish and Israeli students from harassment.

headlines.title: Luigi Mangione expected to plead guilty in New York federal case
headlines.description: Luigi Mangione is expected to plead guilty Friday to federal charges in connection with the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan, according to sources familiar with the matter.
